summary: The nightshift-dlq-depth alarm fired because 131 messages accumulated in the placed-orders dead-letter queue. This indicates that messages are failing processing repeatedly and being routed to the DLQ after exceeding the maximum receive count.
proposed_actions: Inspect messages in the dead-letter queue (nightshift-placed-orders-dlq) to identify the malformed or failing payload, fix the consumer/fulfillment logic if needed, and redrive valid messages.
